methodology.rates: Occurrences divided by draws; main and bonus counts are separate.
methodology.hot: Most main-number appearances in the last window draws; numerical ties.
methodology.frequent: Most main-number appearances across the supplied history; numerical ties.
methodology.cold: Fewest recent appearances; then longest absence; then number.
methodology.limitation: Descriptive history is not evidence of a predictive advantage. Every fixed set of six numbers has the same jackpot probability in a fair, independent draw.
